The act was enacted July 20, 2026 and takes effect July 1, 2027, and it prohibits municipal ordinances that conflict with it. Whether § 218-12 conflicts with the act, and so would be preempted, is unresolved. P.L.2026, c.43 may preempt Jersey City Code § 218-12.
